text: The attached report presents updates on activities undertaken by Toronto Atmospheric Fund (TAF) in 2018, in keeping with the approved Business Plan. It also includes outcomes achieved including results on TAF's Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and reflections on challenges encountered and lessons learned.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Received the report (February 7, 2019) from the Vice President, Programs and Partnerships for information.
